title: Inside The Two Argentinas Under Javier Milei
summary:
President Javier Milei has brought inflation down and opened Argentina to more investment, helping fuel a boom in energy and other export industries. But manufacturing, retail and small businesses are struggling, leaving many Argentines feeling that the recovery is passing them by. One year before the election, Milei’s biggest test may be unifying an increasingly fragmented economy.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zero-Day Option Traders Are Betting Against Big S&P 500 Swings

title: Halloween Candy Prices Reflect Cocoa’s Wild Ride
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Ignacio Canalas Polo explains why chocolate and Halloween candy remain expensive even after cocoa prices retreated from their peaks, pointing to persistent supply pressures in Ivory Coast and Ghana and manufacturers’ efforts to manage costs. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Polo says consumers may see more promotions, but structurally higher cocoa costs and product reformulation mean chocolate prices are unlikely to return quickly to previous levels. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Looks Set to Pause After September Rate Hike
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News Federal Reserve reporter Maria Eloisa Capurro previews the Fed’s upcoming rate decision, with policymakers widely expected to pause after September’s first rate increase since 2023 despite inflation remaining above target. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Capurro explains why investors will scrutinize Chair Kevin Warsh’s language for clues about another potential rate increase and his efforts to reshape how the central bank approaches monetary policy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Brazil Election: Lula Rallies Supporters for One Last Comeback
